asr.boundary: Quality only. Identical sample ranges/settings reuse the same actual model hypothesis; no latency comparison. Full source references include content after a potential early endpoint. Neural edges use first >=0.5 frame, last >=0.35 frame and 160ms padding, without removing interior silence. This candidate edge policy is not shipped.

limitations: Public development fixtures reused from OSpr research, not a sealed holdout or a standard VAD benchmark.
Gain/noise/padding variants share the same forty read-English utterances; they are not independent samples.
Source clip end is a conservative content boundary, not an acoustic last-word annotation.
AMI only_words/manual-segment masks are timing proxies, not hand-labeled speech/non-speech frames; no collar is applied.
Synthetic negative controls do not represent real keyboards, music, echo or physical microphone routes.
The Core ML 32ms model is v6.0; Core ML 256ms and MLX 32ms use v6.2.1. Runtime and model-version effects are confounded.
Resident serial inference timing on a shared active Mac; model loading/priming reported separately. No physical microphone, route changes, sustained real-time queue or power attribution.
New Core ML model/endpoint primitives and CLI are research integration. The GUI and delivered preview still use their existing behavior.
